fields.name: host
fields.label: UFM Host
fields.schema_description: Hostname of the UFM server managing the InfiniBand fabric.
fields.query_param_normalization: single value via searchParams.get('host'); no validation at prefill (ui/src/app/workflows/ibpkeycreationworkflow/form/ib-pkey-creation-form.tsx:65); trimmed by zod on submit
client_only_validation: non-empty after trim ('Host is required'); schema is type string with no minLength

fields.name: pkey
fields.label: PKey (optional)
fields.description: Dynamic help below the input (ib-pkey-creation-form.tsx:46-55): blank -> 'Leave blank to auto-assign the next free PKey.'; not matching /^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]{1,4}$/ -> 'Expected format: 0x followed by 1-4 hex digits (e.g. 0x8001). Server will reject if invalid.'; otherwise 'Will be canonicalized server-side to 0xNNNN.' Placeholder '0x8001 (leave blank to auto-assign)'.
fields.schema_description: Partition key to create; automatically allocated when omitted.
fields.query_param_normalization: single value via searchParams.get('pkey'); no validation at prefill (ui/src/app/workflows/ibpkeycreationworkflow/form/ib-pkey-creation-form.tsx:66)
fields.submit_transform: zod .trim(); key omitted when the trimmed value is empty (never sent as "" or null) (ui/src/app/workflows/ibpkeycreationworkflow/form/ib-pkey-creation-form.tsx:76-77)

payload_transform: params = {host: trimmed host}; params.pkey is added only when the trimmed pkey is non-empty (ui/src/app/workflows/ibpkeycreationworkflow/form/ib-pkey-creation-form.tsx:76-77). No other keys are ever sent. startWorkflow POSTs JSON.stringify(params) to workflowApiUrl + '/v1/workflow/ngc/ib_pkey_creation' (credentials: include, Content-Type: application/json); 2xx redirects to /workflows/{id}; non-2xx throws result.error ?? result.detail and the form shows a destructive 'Workflow Failed' toast (ui/src/lib/utils.tsx:153-184).
discrepancies: Schema fields not rendered and never submitted: site (anyOf[string, null], default null), site_type (anyOf[$ref DCIMLocationType, null], default null, no schema title), ip_over_ib (boolean, default true), pkey_min (integer, default 1), pkey_max (integer, default 32766) (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/workflows/ib_pkey_creation.py:92-110). Legacy POST body is only {host} or {host, pkey}.

IBPKeyCreationInput has no pkey validator (ib_pkey_creation.py:99-101), unlike the member-add/update/delete inputs (_ib_pkey_helpers.py:60-68). A malformed pkey is accepted at POST and only fails at runtime when validate_pkey_available calls int(pkey, 16) (packages/workflows/src/nv_config_manager_workflows/activities/ib_pkey/ufm_activities.py:76-77); the requested value is used as-is (ufm_activities.py:83), not canonicalized at input time. The UI comment (ui/src/app/workflows/ibpkeycreationworkflow/form/ib-pkey-creation-form.tsx:31) and hint copy ('Server will reject if invalid', 'Will be canonicalized server-side to 0xNNNN') overstate input-time validation.

Playwright 'shows hint when pkey is non-canonical and lets server decide' (ui/tests/e2e/ibPkeyCreationForm.spec.ts:85-101) passes only because the MSW mock rejects the POST with 400 (ui/src/mocks/handlers/ibPkeyCreationHandlers.ts:26,42); the real API would accept it and the workflow would fail later.
host: UI rejects empty/whitespace (ui/src/app/workflows/ibpkeycreationworkflow/form/ib-pkey-creation-form.tsx:35); schema only requires presence (type string, no minLength).
Labels differ from schema titles: 'UFM Host' vs 'Host', 'PKey (optional)' vs 'Pkey'; schema descriptions are not displayed.
Blank pkey: legacy omits the key (server default null -> auto-assign). If a renderer sent pkey: "" the model would accept it and the runtime would fail on int('', 16).
contract_gaps: The legacy form does not expose site, site_type, ip_over_ib, pkey_min, or pkey_max, so the generic form must hide or omit those schema fields to preserve payload parity.
Optional scalars serialize as anyOf[T, null] (pkey, site, site_type), so the renderer must support nullable anyOf fields for this flat form.
Blank-optional semantics are undefined: legacy omits pkey when blank; the contract does not say whether an empty text input submits "", null, or omits the key.
Value-dependent help text (three variants keyed on the current pkey value) has no v1 equivalent; help is static.
site_type has no schema title (anyOf with $ref), so an inferred label falls back to the key.
